Synopsis:
A shooting at a rave in Aarau, Switzerland killed a 22-year-old Italian woman (Maria Spinelli) and injured five others. Swiss police arrested a 43-year-old Swiss male suspect early Monday. Investigators are exploring motives including mass killing, terrorism, or criminal intent. Cartridges found suggest two calibres, possibly including an AK-74-style assault rifle. Investigation is ongoing.
